notes.title: Cook, Serve, Delicious! 3?! Coming to Steam EA January 2020!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32938532/a45d6a3944e0b91fdcb8308ccc9254a0e79e282d.jpg[/img]

I'm so thrilled to announce Cook, Serve, Delicious! 3?! is coming soon to Steam Early Access! It's one of the biggest sequels I've ever done, and there's so much to say I don't even know where to start.

Let's start with the gameplay reveal trailer!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-1n8GvE__Ps

You can wishlist the game on Steam today!! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1000030/Cook_Serve_Delicious_3/

We're also going to be showcasing the game at PAX! More details on that to come this week!

Also I'm excited to announce that the CSD series has sold over one million copies across PC/mobile/console! Holy cow!! I want to thank you for all the love and support y'all have given me over the years. I deeply appreciate it and I can't wait to make this game the best one ever.

[b]For more details including private beta access, visit the discord: [/b]https://discordapp.com/invite/cookservedelicious

Thanks everyone and I'll be back later this week for PAX news and more!!

notes.title: Cook, Serve, Delicious! Plushies Now Available!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32938532/c0101c42241d2986d7c82bd47ed58bc2c27b7616.png[/img]

We’ve gotten requests for CSD-related merchandise for quite some time now, and we wanted to take the time to make sure our first merch would be both high quality and something really special. And so I present to you…Sundae, the mascot from Chilly Bowl (CSD2)! This adorable 10” ice cream mascot is now available at Indiebox, and supplies are limited…once they’re gone, they’re gone!

[url=https://theindiebox.com/collections/cook-serve-delicious/products/cook-serve-delicious-sundae-plushie]Check it out on IndieBox![/url]

But the CSD shenanigans doesn’t stop there, as we now have a Cook, Serve, Delicious Instagram account! The only source for delicious high quality food pics, this Instagram channel will be posting new updates every week with mouthwatering deliciousness. [url=https://www.instagram.com/cookservedelicious/]Give it a follow to see for yourself![/url]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32938532/203d38dc084eb4a1f887376a78b71295f95a4f6a.png[/img]

I have one other piece of news…but that will have to wait for another day. I’ll just say that if you’re a fan of our games in general, you’ll definitely want to be the first to hear this cool news later this year! Be sure to [url=https://twitter.com/chubigans]follow us on Twitter[/url] and [url=https://vertigogaming.us18.list-manage.com/subscribe?u=68d4a092ccafb67cd61b7d1d8&id=97cc0a6ed0]subscribe to our newsletter[/url] to get the first scoop on this forthcoming announcement. ːcsdsmileː ːcsd2smileː
